content.value_statement: Creating reliable Excel workbooks requires careful formula, formatting, and data handling. This skill provides structured workflows for building, editing, and analyzing spreadsheets with Python tools.
actual_capabilities: Create Excel workbooks with styled headers, formulas, and calculated totals.
Read existing worksheets and calculate basic statistics from cell values.
Edit workbooks while preserving formulas and worksheet structure.
Transform CSV or Excel data with pandas and write formatted reports.
Create charts, conditional formatting, and data validation rules.
Work with multi-sheet workbooks and cross-sheet formulas.
limitations: It does not execute Excel macros or validate macro security.
Formula results may require Excel or a compatible application to recalculate.
It does not replace review of sensitive spreadsheet data before sharing.
Large files may require read-only, write-only, or chunked processing.

use_cases.title: Prepare a sales report
use_cases.description: Create a formatted sales workbook with quarterly data, totals, and a trend chart.

use_cases.title: Convert source data into a report
use_cases.description: Transform CSV data into a multi-sheet Excel report with summaries and styling.

use_cases.title: Update a recurring workbook
use_cases.description: Modify an existing workbook while preserving formulas and established layouts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excel workbook named sales_report.xlsx with Product, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, and Total columns. Add formulas for each row total.

prompt_templates.title: Format an existing sheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Open my workbook, format the header row, set currency formatting for revenue columns, and preserve all existing formulas.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze source data
prompt_templates.prompt: Read sales_data.xlsx, summarize sales and profit by product, then save the results in a new Summary worksheet.

prompt_templates.title: Build a management dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive Excel dashboard from this dataset with KPI cells, a monthly trend chart, category comparison chart, and clear data validation.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly sales workbook with totals.
output: A workbook with product and quarterly sales columns.
A Total column containing formulas for every product row.
A styled header row and readable column widths.
A Summary worksheet with total sales, average sales, transaction counts, and total profit.
Source data retained in a separate worksheet.
Number formats applied to financial values.

best_practices: Preserve formulas by loading workbooks without data_only when editing them.
Validate input data types and handle missing cells before calculations.
Use read-only or write-only modes for large workbooks to control memory use.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite the original workbook before verifying the output.
Do not use data_only when you need to preserve formulas during editing.
Do not process large worksheets cell by cell inside nested loops.

faq.question: Which files can this skill help with?
faq.answer: It covers .xlsx, .xlsm, and CSV workflows described by the skill.

faq.question: Can it preserve formulas when editing a workbook?
faq.answer: Yes. Load the workbook without data_only and save the edited workbook.

faq.question: Can it create Excel charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes workflows for line, bar, and pie charts.

faq.question: Does it support pandas?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents pandas workflows for analysis and Excel export.

faq.question: Can it handle large files?
faq.answer: Yes. Use read-only, write-only, or chunked processing as appropriate.

faq.question: Does it run Excel macros?
faq.answer: No. Macro execution and macro security review are outside this skill.
